focus: The ranked per-phase expansion plan: which phases become parents with which children, which single cross-cutting artifact closes the most findings, and what design artifacts the user-facing surfaces still need.
noveltyJustification: The plan is synthesis over nine iterations of cited findings, so 6 of 8 findings are new arrangements of prior evidence and 2 restate earlier verdicts.
keyQuestions: Which single artifact closes the most findings?
answeredQuestions: Which single artifact closes the most findings?
ruledOut: Making 003 six-child shape the template for every phase
Treating the contract document as a fifteenth phase

label: 011-messaging-channels is the only phase that must become a parent: 29 files, 23 requirements, nine modules and five transports, split into six children (shared adapter and contract, identity link and roster, approval index and queue, Telegram and Slack, Signal and WhatsApp, conformance and hardening).

One packet-level contract document closes fifteen findings: the refusal catalogue with class and pre/post-dispatch kind, the exit-code table, the schema-version rule, the single-writer map, the shared-record ownership table and the target-state module map with the state-root tree.
008-vault needs a contract addendum rather than children: the secrets name grammar, the SKILLED_BOT_SECRET_<NAME> mapping table, the store index schema and the migration runbook.

Six phases need exactly one addendum artifact each: 001 item lifecycle and answer nullability, 002 routine state and until observation, 005 memory entry grammar and prompt section order, 006 item and grant key ownership, 009 skill-name grammar and proposal keys, 010 json envelope and chat mockups.

The three closing phases need one rule each: 012 a FAIL blocks close plus a corpus re-run after 014, 013 copies its reports into the packet and names 014 as receiver, 014 an absent-executor rule and 012 results.csv as a review input.
Only 003 has design artifacts; 010 chat and 011 channel messages are user-facing and have no mockup, wireframe or message-shape diagram, which is the packet remaining design gap.
007 and 004 are ready and need nothing: 004 is the best one-shot-ready small phase and 007 has only P2 findings.
The ranked order is 011, then the contract document, then 008, then the six addenda in dependency order, then the three closing rules, with 007 and 004 needing nothing.
